title: Daikon Hash with Canadian Kissed Cheese
description: A simple yet flavorful dish combining the sweetness of daikon with the richness of Canadian kissed cheese, all wrapped up in a crispy hash. Enjoy as a brunch or side dish.
instructions: Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add grated daikon and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add shredded hash brown potatoes and cook until golden brown.
Stir in shredded Canadian Kissed cheese until melted.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
